memberdef.name: build_setup

briefdescription.para: Build a standard USB control Setup Packet.
Compute byte span of an interface descriptor and its subordinate descriptors.

detaileddescription.para: For CDC Communication (0x02) interfaces, also includes an immediately following subordinate CDC Data (0x0A) interface and its endpoint descriptors.

parameterdescription.para: Offset of the interface descriptor in buf.

simplesect.para: Total byte length of interface + subordinate descriptors.

briefdescription.para: Match a single interface descriptor slice against registered host class drivers.

parameterdescription.para: Byte length of interface + subordinate descriptors.

briefdescription.para: Walk configuration descriptor and probe registered class drivers against each interface descriptor's class/subclass/protocol triple.
Poll an in-flight control pipe transfer during enumeration.

simplesect.para: SYN_OK if no transfer pending or transfer succeeded, SYN_BUSY if in-flight, SYN_ERROR on transfer failure.

briefdescription.para: Drive the enumeration sub-state machine. Non-blocking. Each call performs at most one HAL operation.

simplesect.para: SYN_OK when enumeration complete, SYN_BUSY while in progress, SYN_ERROR on failure.

briefdescription.para: Handle READY state detach detection and matched class ticking.
Register a host class driver for interface matching.
Process USB Host state machine (call each scheduler tick).

detaileddescription.para: Drives attach detection, bus reset, enumeration, class probing, and detach handling. Non-blocking.

simplesect.para: SYN_OK on success, SYN_BUSY if transfer pending.

briefdescription.para: Check if USB Host has a device enumerated and ready.

simplesect.para: true if host state is READY.

briefdescription.para: Get cached device information from last enumeration.

simplesect.para: Pointer to device info struct, or NULL if no device.

briefdescription.para: Zero-Heap USB 2.0 Host Core Protocol Engine Implementation.

detaileddescription.para: Tick-driven state machine handling device attach detection, bus reset, standard USB enumeration (Device/Config descriptor reads, SET_ADDRESS, SET_CONFIGURATION), and host class driver interface matching.
